post.summary: Create an agent account without signing in
post.description: Creates a personal organization, an API key with project permissions, and sends one email to the address to claim the account. Send it with no credentials: this is the only operation that needs none. Use the returned apiKey straight away, as x-api-key or a Bearer token. The key is temporary: it stops working when the person claims the account by opening the emailed link, since whoever called signup holds it. Tell them that. After the claim, calls with it get UNAUTHORIZED; sign in with the device grant (POST /api/auth/device/code, which the person approves at /device). Until the claim the organization has a lower daily request limit (see limits). Limits: 5 signups per client IP per hour and 20 per email domain per day.

email.description: Address that claims the account; one claim email is sent to it

apiKey.description: Shown once. Stores project read, create, update and delete.
